description: Update an existing assignment in a course.

due_at.description: New due date in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2026-05-01T23:59:00Z)

grade_group_students_individually.description: For group assignments, whether each member is graded separately (false = one shared group grade)

lock_at.description: New date after which the assignment locks and stops accepting submissions, in ISO 8601 format. Must be after due_at when there is one

omit_from_final_grade.description: Whether to leave this assignment out of the final grade calculation

published.description: Whether the assignment is published and visible to students

unlock_at.description: New date the assignment becomes available to students, in ISO 8601 format. Must be before due_at when there is one

name: update_assignment
title: Update Assignment
